before:
Spoke & Chain

Bike repairs in Leeds, done properly and done fast.

We are a small independent workshop run by two mechanics who have been fixing bikes since we were founded in 2019. Whether you ride to work every day or dust off a bike for weekends, we will get you back on the road.

Same-day repairs for jobs under £40. Bring your bike in the morning and, for most smaller jobs, collect it the same afternoon. Flat tyres, brake adjustments, gear tuning, and chain replacements are all part of the daily work here.

Open Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00. Drop in during opening hours or check ahead if you have a tricky problem.

We keep things simple: honest quotes before any work starts, and no surprises when you pick up your bike. Visit us in Leeds today.
